source.active_destination: normalized node metadata, semantic sidecars, structured edit profiles, render/reparse fixtures, and family/provider-local helpers

portable_comment_contracts.contract: Providers may project leading, inline, trailing, orphan, preamble, and postlude comment regions into normalized metadata or semantic sidecars.
Comment styles use normalized identifiers for hash, HTML, C-style line, C-style block, semicolon, and double-dash comments when the provider exposes them.
Freeze marker detection uses the shared slice-843 directive vocabulary rather than format-specific marker classes.
Multi-line comment regions may text-submerge only behind profile and family fixture evidence; inline comments preserve the preferred side by default.

portable_layout_contracts.contract: Blank-line gaps are classified as preamble, interstitial, or postlude.
Adjacent owners may both reference one gap, but only one owner controls output.
When a controlling owner is removed, eligible interstitial and boundary gaps may fall back to the surviving adjacent owner.
Layout-sensitive edits report controller side, fallback side, retained owners, removed owners, and render/reparse outcome.

portable_structural_edit_contracts.contract: Line-range replacement preserves source before and after the edited range exactly.
Removal reports removed owners, retained boundaries, promoted comment regions, and promoted layout gaps.
Rehome plans record transfer intent from removed owners to surviving boundaries without mutating provider-native trees directly.
Batched line-range edits must be non-overlapping and applied against one source version.
Injection point and section selectors become structured edit destination profiles, not a separate public navigable API.

injection-point matching is superseded by structured edit selectors and destination profiles
old SmartMerger inheritance is retired; line/text fallback must be profile-gated and reportable

renderer_ownership.claim_requirement: A provider must not claim layout-sensitive preservation until family fixtures verify render and reparse behavior.

decision: Keep comment, layout, structural edit, navigable, and text fallback behavior as fixture-backed contracts. Do not copy the old public helper class hierarchy in this pass; reintroduce passive records only as local conveniences when active providers need them.
